svg.title: Ryan — Codex NightView, mint edition
svg.desc: 69,755,208,247 Codex tokens from Token Monitor across 122 completed dates, 2026-07-20 to 2026-11-18. Cache and reasoning are included once in the exported total. A 13-week isometric calendar adapted from GitHub Profile 3D Contrib NightView. Heights are logarithmic. Missing dates are unknown, not zero. All-device coverage is not established.
